texts.zh: 我们失去了对[FromFrom.GetName]的控制，它被活雪夺走了！在[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]的生态系统中已经开始发生非常明显的变化。我们的[This.GetResearchers]提醒，除非我们能尽快夺回[FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]，否则它的构造变化很快将使我们无法再继续居住。
texts.en: We have lost control of [FromFrom.GetName] - which has been seized by the Living Snow! Already, significant changes are happening to the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon]'s ecosystem. Our [This.GetResearchers] warn that, unless we can retake the [FromFrom.GetPlanetMoon], its makeup will soon be changed beyond our ability to inhabit it.

tooltips.zh: 我们应该尽快夺回行星，否则就来不及了！
tooltips.en: We should retake the planet, before it's too late!

texts.zh: 随着活雪对[Root.GetName]控制权的巩固，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]也变得越来越冷，它的大气条件在越来越快地发生改变。可以说，这颗星球现在已经不可居住了。目前暂不清楚我们是否能够将其恢复到之前的状态……不过我们的[saved_owner.GetResearchers]确信，在这些雪发现了自身的新存在形态，并通过自身独特的化学反应将整个[Root.GetName]变得天翻地覆之后，我们可以通过研究这些雪的独特行为学会许多有趣的东西。
texts.en: With the Living Snow consolidating its control over [Root.GetName], the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] has become ever colder, its atmospheric conditions changing at an ever-increasing rate. Now, the world can no longer be considered inhabitable. It is unclear whether we will ever be able to restore it to its former state... but our [saved_owner.GetResearchers] assure us that much of interest can be learned by observing the antics of the snow as it discovers its new state of being - and its unique chemical reactions which have wrought such change upon [Root.GetName].
